title: PATRIOT OVERVIEW
body: As an independent insurance intermediary, Patriot Growth Insurance Services delivers a full spectrum of insurance, risk-management, and consulting solutions through our national platform. The solutions we offer, at a minimum, are Property & Casualty, Personal Lines, and Group Health Benefits.
Patriot blends the strategic strength of a national platform with deep local expertise, ensuring clients receive tailored solutions backed by broad carrier access and technical capability.
